maddeler.e:
شعوا (form I)
# شَعُّوا (šaʕʕū) /ʃaʕ.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of شَعَّ (šaʕʕa)
# شُعُّوا (šuʕʕū) /ʃuʕ.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of شَعَّ (šaʕʕa)
# شِعُّوا (šiʕʕū) /ʃiʕ.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of شَعَّ (šaʕʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
